description: Vectors for the authenticated connection and the bootstrap (docs/auth/connection.md): the audience a connection binds to, the connection proof in nightseam-auth/1, the exchange that makes a connection's context, the per-call decision at use, and login transcripts over Archon's scheme with recovery. Every input that is entropy or time is given, so every byte is deterministic. Envelopes named as in auth-grant.json are byte-identical to it. now is seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC; null is no trusted time.
